topic: Mastering the Cross Product: From 2D intuition to 3D mechanics

sections.title: Prerequisites & The 2D 'Shadow' (0:00-0:45)
animations: Draw two vectors u, v on 2D plane (color: #FFFFFF).
Draw parallelogram spanned by u and v.
Shade area (#FF0000) for clockwise orientation.
Shade area (#0000FF) for counter-clockwise orientation.
Scale parallelogram to highlight area magnitude.

sections.title: Transition to 3D: The Geometry of Space (0:45-2:00)
animations: Show u, v in 3D perspective (#FFFFFF).
Draw the normal vector result (w = u x v) (#00FF00).
Demonstrate orthogonality using 90-degree visual cues.
Use Right-Hand Rule animation to verify direction.
Animate w growing with parallelogram area.

sections.title: The Algebraic Mechanic: Determinant Method (2:00-3:30)
lecture_lines: Calculate i, j, and k components.
animations: Display 3x3 matrix with components i, j, k.
Highlight row 1 and column 1 to show first minor.
Highlight row 1 and column 2 for second minor.
Highlight row 1 and column 3 for third minor.
Show final vector result components.

sections.title: Physical Application: Torque (3:30-4:30)
lecture_lines: Cross product relates radius and force.
animations: Draw pivot point and force vector F.
Draw position vector r from pivot to F.
Animate cross product r x F to show torque.

sections.title: Summary & Quick Recall (4:30-5:00)
lecture_lines: Right-hand rule is your direction guide.
animations: Display text '2D: Scalar Area' (#FF0000).
Display text '3D: Vector Orthogonal' (#00FF00).
Show Right-Hand Rule icon as final summary.
